basic_info.description: Located on a tree lined street in coveted Hayes Valley, this spacious top floor condo with ample light boasts classic details with thoughtful modern updates;  period details including crown molding, original hardwood floors, doors, and fireplace. The renovated kitchen features modern appliances and a large farmhouse sink. The split-bathroom has been updated with design-grade fixtures and finishes. Additional features include 1-car covered parking, generously sized storage room, walk-in closet, low HOA and move-in ready. Buyers will appreciate this rare, well designed home just moments from NOPA, Castro and Hayes Valley shops, restaurants, coffee shops, gyms, Duboce and Buena Vista Parks, as well as multiple Muni Lines, tech shuttles and easy access to the freeways.
